name: Home BancShares, Inc.
summary: Home BancShares, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Centennial Bank that provides commercial and retail banking, and related financial services to businesses, real estate developers and investors, individuals, and municipalities in the United States. The company offers deposit services, including checking, savings, and money market accounts, as well as certificates of deposit. It also provides loans comprising non-farm/non-residential real estate, construction/land development, residential mortgage, consumer, agricultural, and commercial and industrial loans.
